title: Cramer says Marvell's surge on Jensen Huang's $1 trillion prediction is concerning. Here's why
raw_text:
Key Points
- Jim Cramer said Marvell' rally after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang called it the "next trillion-dollar company" is concerning.
- While he remains bullish on Marvell and CEO Matt Murphy, he cautioned against chasing the growing euphoria around artificial intelligence stocks that surge without fundamental drivers.
